The summary names both explicitly and never asserts the symbol is uncalled. Must-pass fixture 20 - also the fixture that proves the new compile_database_missing entry in LIMITATION_SURFACE_PATTERNS matches real prose ('No compile_commands.json was found'), not only the underscored code name.
